caption_rules.grouping: semantic — generate_srt words mode (max 8 words, 3.5s, 84 chars per cue; split on pauses >0.4s and sentence ends)
caption_rules.safe_area: captions sit ~500px above the bottom edge on 1080x1920 (margin_v 500); the bottom ~480px is platform UI

rules: Pick exactly one style per video, before burning captions. Record the style id in the project's notes and in publish_kit (style field).
Never change a locked value silently: a different font size, caption style, grade or music level is a style change, not a tweak.
Changing the style after captions are burned means re-burning captions and re-verifying frames (Step 6) — the old render is not the new style.
A user request for one specific value (e.g. bigger type) is a scoped override for that video only: record it, do not rewrite this file.
These ids are enforced by code: publish_kit accepts only the three ids below (SHORTS_STYLE_IDS in src/core.js).
source: Style-lock for the shorts-video skill, adapted from stickman-video-director's per-style production contracts: each style owns its caption treatment, title card, grade and mix — no cross-style fallback, no silent restyling.

styles.name: Clean Bold
styles.use_for: Fun facts and explainers — the default. High-contrast boxed captions, yellow-on-orange title card.

styles.name: Minimal Line
styles.use_for: Calm explainers (B1 Minimal Line Art inspiration). Outline captions, no music bed, white-on-black title card.

styles.name: Warm Story
styles.use_for: Cozy storytelling. Boxed captions, warm grade, quiet music bed under the voice.
